comments.body:
_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟠 Major_

<details>
<summary>🧩 Analysis chain</summary>

🏁 Script executed:

```shell
cat -n code/frameworks/react-native-web-vite/template/cli/js/Button.jsx | head -70
```

Repository: storybookjs/storybook

Length of output: 2066

---

🌐 Web query:

`React Native ViewStyle vs TextStyle properties fontWeight lineHeight color valid`

💡 Result:

In React Native:

- **`fontWeight`** → **TextStyle only** (apply to `<Text />`, not `<View />`). [1]  
- **`lineHeight`** → **TextStyle only** (typography). [1]  
- **`color`** → **TextStyle only** (text color). A `<View />` uses things like `backgroundColor`, border colors, etc., but not `color`. [1][2]  

So in TypeScript, these are valid on **`TextStyle`** (and `StyleProp<TextStyle>`), but **not** on **`ViewStyle`** (and `StyleProp<ViewStyle>`). [1][2]

**Sources:**  
[1] React Native Text Style Props (color, fontWeight, lineHeight) https://reactnative.dev/docs/0.77/text-style-props  
[2] React Native View Style Props (no color/fontWeight/lineHeight) https://reactnative.dev/docs/0.78/view-style-props

---



</details>

**Remove text-only style properties from View component styles.**

Lines 41-42 and 58 apply `fontWeight`, `lineHeight`, and `color` to `<View>` component styles, but these are TextStyle-only properties in React Native and will not take effect on `<View>` or `<TouchableOpacity>`. The `color` property in `styles.secondary` has no effect, and the `fontWeight`/`lineHeight` duplicates in `styles.button` are ineffective (proper text styling already exists in `styles.buttonText` on lines 45-47).

<details>
<summary>Remove the ineffective properties</summary>

```diff
  button: {
    borderWidth: 0,
    borderRadius: 48,
-   fontWeight: '700',
-   lineHeight: 1,
  },
@@
  secondary: {
    backgroundColor: 'transparent',
    borderColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)',
-   color: '#333',
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
```
</details>

<!-- suggestion_start -->

<details>
<summary>📝 Committable suggestion</summary>

> ‼️ **IMPORTANT**
> Carefully review the code before committing. Ensure that it accurately replaces the highlighted code, contains no missing lines, and has no issues with indentation. Thoroughly test & benchmark the code to ensure it meets the requirements.

```suggestion
  button: {
    borderWidth: 0,
    borderRadius: 48,
  },
```

```suggestion
  secondary: {
    backgroundColor: 'transparent',
    borderColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)',
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
```

</details>

<!-- suggestion_end -->

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed.

In `@code/frameworks/react-native-web-vite/template/cli/js/Button.jsx` around
lines 41 - 42, Remove text-only properties from View/TouchableOpacity style
objects: delete fontWeight and lineHeight from styles.button and remove color
from styles.secondary because React Native applies those only to Text; keep text
formatting in styles.buttonText (which already contains the proper
fontWeight/lineHeight/color). Update the style definitions where styles.button,
styles.secondary are declared so only layout/background/border/padding/etc.
remain on View/TouachableOpacity and all text-related styling remains in
styles.buttonText.
```

</details>

---

🌐 Web query:

`React Native ViewStyle vs TextStyle fontWeight lineHeight color support`

💡 Result:

In React Native, **`fontWeight`**, **`lineHeight`**, and **`color`** are **Text-only style props** (i.e., **`TextStyle`**), not **`ViewStyle`**.

| Style prop | `ViewStyle` (e.g., `<View />`) | `TextStyle` (e.g., `<Text />`) |
|---|---:|---:|
| `fontWeight` | No | Yes ([reactnative.dev](https://reactnative.dev/docs/0.77/text-style-props?utm_source=openai)) |
| `lineHeight` | No | Yes ([reactnative.dev](https://reactnative.dev/docs/0.75/text-style-props?utm_source=openai)) |
| `color` (text color) | No | Yes ([reactnative.dev](https://reactnative.dev/docs/0.75/text-style-props?utm_source=openai)) |

Notes:
- `<View />` uses **view-specific color props** like `backgroundColor`, `borderColor`, etc. ([reactnative.dev](https://reactnative.dev/docs/0.78/view-style-props?utm_source=openai))
- In TypeScript, you’ll get errors if you type a style as `ViewStyle` and include `color` / `fontWeight` / etc., because `ViewStyle` doesn’t define them. ([stackoverflow.com](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/73493571/type-script-react-native-viewstyle-type-issue?utm_source=openai))

Example (TypeScript):
```ts
import type { TextStyle, ViewStyle } from "react-native";

const viewStyle: ViewStyle = { /* no color/fontWeight/lineHeight */ };
const textStyle: TextStyle = { color: "red", fontWeight: "700", lineHeight: 20 };
```

Citations:

- 1: https://reactnative.dev/docs/0.77/text-style-props?utm_source=openai
- 2: https://reactnative.dev/docs/0.75/text-style-props?utm_source=openai
- 3: https://reactnative.dev/docs/0.75/text-style-props?utm_source=openai
- 4: https://reactnative.dev/docs/0.78/view-style-props?utm_source=openai
- 5: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/73493571/type-script-react-native-viewstyle-type-issue?utm_source=openai

**Move text-only style props to text styles.**

Lines 55-56 place `fontWeight` and `lineHeight` on the `button` View style, and line 72 places `color` on the `secondary` View style. These are text-only properties in React Native (supported only on `TextStyle`, not `ViewStyle`) and will be silently ignored when applied to `<View>` elements.

Move `fontWeight` and `lineHeight` to the appropriate text style (the Text component is styled at line 45), and move `color` from `secondary` to `secondaryText` where it already exists at line 76.
